```yaml
name: Copilot SDK Client CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'copilot-client/**'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-sdk-ci.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'copilot-client/**'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-sdk-ci.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: copilot-client/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: copilot-client
        run: npm ci

      - name: Extract Copilot Version
        id: version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(grep 'DefaultCopilotVersion' pkg/constants/constants.go | sed -E 's/.*"([^"]+)".*/\1/')
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Using Copilot version: $VERSION"

      - name: Build TypeScript client
        working-directory: copilot-client
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        working-directory: copilot-client
        run: npm test
        env:
          COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          COPILOT_VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}

      - name: Upload Test Results
        if: always()
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          files: "copilot-client/**/*.xml"
```
